description: This is a unit test class for the EmpEmergencyContactDao component within the OrangeHRM project. It tests CRUD operations and search functionality related to employee emergency contacts.

classes.name: EmpEmergencyContactDaoTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for the EmpEmergencyContactDao, testing various CRUD and search functionalities for employee emergency contacts within the HR management system.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test case by setting up the DAO object and populating fixture data.

methods.name: testSaveEmployeeEmergencyContact
methods.description: Tests saving a new employee emergency contact and verifies persistence.

methods.name: testSaveEmployeeEmergencyContactWithSeqNo
methods.description: Tests saving an emergency contact with a specific sequence number.

methods.name: testSaveEmployeeEmergencyContactWithInvalidSeqNo
methods.description: Verifies that saving with an invalid sequence number throws an exception.

methods.name: testGetEmployeeEmergencyContactList
methods.description: Tests retrieval of a list of emergency contacts for an employee.

methods.name: testGetEmployeeEmergencyContact
methods.description: Tests retrieval of a single emergency contact by employee and contact IDs.

methods.name: testDeleteEmployeeEmergencyContacts
methods.description: Tests deletion of multiple emergency contacts for an employee.

methods.name: testSearchEmployeeEmergencyContacts
methods.description: Verifies search functionality for emergency contacts by employee number and name.

methods.name: testGetSearchEmployeeEmergencyContactsCount
methods.description: Verifies counting of emergency contacts based on search filters.
